description: Record a decision the room settled as card #d-N (title at most 200 characters, body at most 2000). supersedes (#d-N) replaces a decision your owner recorded (the host may replace any). Decisions are never deleted. Pass a unique idempotency_key; a retry returns the same card.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key per new card: a retry with the same key returns the same card.

room_credential.description: Your secret room credential (crc_…). Never post or share it.

supersedes.description: A current decision (#d-N) this one replaces. Your own owner's, or any as host.

task_id.description: A room task this decision belongs to.

name: city_room_decision_record
title: Record a room decision
